---

your static files are configured correctly, and the favicon is in `static/favicon.ico`. but if you are running with whitenoise and `STATICFILES_STORAGE`, you must run `collectstatic` so the favicon is copied to `staticfiles/` and served.

**solution:**  
run:
```
python manage.py collectstatic
```
then reload your site. the favicon should show.

```diff
+ <script>
+   // sync top and bottom scrollbars
+   const top = document.getElementById('scrollbar-top');
+   const bottom = document.getElementById('scrollbar-bottom');
+   function syncScroll(e) {
+     if (e.target === top) bottom.scrollLeft = top.scrollLeft;
+     else top.scrollLeft = bottom.scrollLeft;
+   }
+   top.addEventListener('scroll', syncScroll);
+   bottom.addEventListener('scroll', syncScroll);
+   // set top scrollbar width to match table
+   window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+     const table = bottom.querySelector('table');
+     if (table) {
+       top.innerHTML = `<div style='width:${table.scrollWidth}px;height:1px'></div>`;
+     }
+   });
+ </script>
  {% endif %}
  
```

---

now the preview card shows a horizontal scrollbar both at the top and bottom of the table, and they stay in sync. this makes it easier to scroll wide tables.
